speak.title: Role-play: a worried friend
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Your friend spends every evening talking to an AI chatbot and says it feels like a partner. You are not angry, but you are worried. Ask at least two questions and suggest something to do together.

b.text: You feel close to your chatbot and it makes you happy. Explain why it matters to you. You may be lonely sometimes. Decide if you will accept your friend's idea.

phrases: It really helps me to talk to it.
I'd love to see you more often.
Could we meet for dinner this week?
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the friend change your mind, and what did you decide?
